paper_identity.title: Synthesis of superheavy nuclei: How accurately can we describe it and calculate the cross sections?

cross_mass_significance: Exposes the catastrophic failure of transferring standard statistical de-excitation models from stable/actinide nuclei to superheavy compound systems (Z >= 114): proves that the inversion of the fission barrier relative to neutron separation energy (B_f < S_n) and thermal shell-damping trigger a multi-chance fission avalanche (Gamma_f/Gamma_n ~ 10^2 - 10^3 per step), crushing evaporation residue survival probabilities down to 10^-6 - 10^-8 (picobarns).
